board.title: Chibi Town noticeboard
board.welcome: Welcome to Chibi Town, the heart of the island!
board.lights: The plaza street lights switch on between 17:30 and 18:30 and go off at dawn.
board.sit: The plaza benches are for everyone: take a seat (E).
board.districts: Roads leave the plaza for Harbor Bay, Sunset Beach, Lumi Forest, Volcano Cliffs, Sky Terrace, Crystal Peak and the south meadow.
board.soon: Coming soon: open shops, neighbours and the stadium. (Honest note: they don't exist in the game yet.)
npc.rina.root: Hi! I'm Rina from the Chibi Island Tourist Information Center. How can I help you?
npc.rina.a.island: The island has seven areas: Chibi Town, right here in the centre; Harbor Bay to the east; Sunset Beach to the south-west; Lumi Forest to the north-west; Volcano Cliffs to the west; Sky Terrace to the north-east and Crystal Peak to the north. Every road starts from this plaza.
npc.rina.a.stars: You earn stars by completing activities and missions. They're forever: never spent, never lost, and once you have enough they unlock new things — even new characters. The first missions open very soon.
npc.rina.a.now: Have a look around the plaza: sit on the bench, read the noticeboard and stay to watch the street lights come on at dusk. Come back and see me any time!
